repo_identity.name: sales-aaas-platform
repo_identity.mission: Public-facing multi-tenant Sales SaaS and AI-assisted sales operations platform.

maturity.target_description: The repository should make production expectations explicit, keep delivery PR-first, require evidence before merge and release, and preserve rollback paths for launch-critical surfaces.
ratchet_rules: Do not lower the baseline of a working system.
Prefer additive hardening over broad rewrites.
Version baseline improvements and keep them rollbackable.
Capture reusable lessons in repo contracts, runbooks, templates, or notes.

production_grade_contract.scope: This file defines repo expectations and evidence gates. It does not change runtime behavior, package dependencies, migrations, workflow triggers, or deploy behavior by itself.
minimum_bar: Preserve shared contract integrity between packages/shared, apps/api, and apps/web.
Keep auth, billing, tenancy, audit events, provider webhooks, and approval gates treated as high-risk surfaces.
Keep public pricing, plan catalog, onboarding plan selection, and API billing behavior aligned or explicitly document intentional divergence.
Hide, gate, or downgrade public claims that are not implemented.
Choose the narrowest meaningful verification first, then broaden when risk or scope requires it.
Final change summaries must state what changed, what was verified, and what remains risky or unverified.

requires_explicit_approval: changing public API or shared contract shapes
changing plan keys, billing behavior, or migration semantics
weakening auth, audit, rate-limit, approval, tenant isolation, or provider webhook verification logic

protected_surfaces.name: auth_and_session
required_evidence: session establishment and workspace-selection smoke evidence
backward compatibility notes for existing sessions when applicable

protected_surfaces.name: tenancy_and_workspace_scope
required_evidence: tenant isolation tests or explicit manual verification

protected_surfaces.name: billing_and_provider_webhooks
required_evidence: checkout, billing portal, payment history, and webhook idempotency tests where touched

protected_surfaces.name: approval_gated_automation
required_evidence: approval policy test coverage where behavior changes

protected_surfaces.name: public_claims_and_pricing_truth
required_evidence: pricing page, shared plan catalog, onboarding selection, and billing route alignment check
claim truth review against implemented behavior

protected_surfaces.name: deploy_and_operating_system
required_evidence: owner and monitoring checklist when production behavior changes

protected_surfaces.name: secrets_and_environment
required_evidence: placeholder defaults do not enable unsafe production behavior

verification_contract.strategy: Run the narrowest meaningful check first, then broaden to full repo gates for cross-boundary, release-sensitive, auth, billing, tenancy, schema, workflow, or public-claim changes.
release_sensitive_gate_additions: targeted tests for touched high-risk surfaces
manual smoke for /get-started, /dashboard, /billing, and /health when auth, billing, tenant, dashboard, or deploy behavior changes
verification_contract.evidence_rule: Do not claim completion from green checks alone. State which risks the checks covered and which risks remain unverified.

required_for_every_pr: test, typecheck, build, and smoke evidence appropriate to risk
rollback plan or statement that the change is metadata-only and can be reverted
confirmation that runtime behavior, dependencies, migrations, workflows, and deploy behavior were or were not changed
required_for_high_risk_surfaces: targeted test evidence for the touched protected surface
migration or provider failure-mode notes when applicable
auditability and tenant isolation review when applicable
manual critical-journey smoke plan before production promotion
required_before_merge: CI status is visible or local substitute is documented
reviewer can reproduce the verification commands
public claims remain aligned with implementation truth
forbidden_evidence_patterns: claiming verification without command output or observed smoke evidence
using demo-only behavior as proof of production readiness
leaving rollback_action undefined for release-sensitive work

release_path: Create a scoped branch from the latest main.
Open a PR with evidence, risk, rollout, and rollback notes.
Require CI and repo operating system checks to pass or document an approved blocker-specific substitute.
For production-sensitive changes, deploy to staging first.
Run automated gates and credential-dependent smoke checks where available.
Promote to production only after owner review of customer-visible risk and rollback posture.
Monitor health, auth, billing, dashboard, provider/webhook, and approval-sensitive signals after deploy.
Capture post-release evidence and rollback decision.
abort_conditions: billing checkout, portal, or webhook verification fails
dashboard truth is wrong or unavailable
provider or webhook verification errors spike
approval-required workflow can dispatch without approval
public pricing or claims become materially inaccurate
release.rollback_action: Redeploy the last known-good Cloudflare worker versions for web, api, and workflows, then rerun npm run smoke:cloudflare
rollback_notes: Prefer behavior rollback over schema rollback.
Only roll schema back when the migration has an explicitly safe rollback path.
Disable unsafe public entry points or provider channels when a narrower operational mitigation is safer than a full rollback.
Record whether rollback was considered or executed in release evidence.
